no_fees_slow.title: Before fees, slow competition
no_fees_slow.blurb: No taker fee; makers re-quote every ~2 s and rival bots react in ~400 ms. The conditions the viral posts describe.

fees_slow.title: Taker fee, slow competition
fees_slow.blurb: The identical market, but our taker fills now pay 0.07 · p · (1 − p) per share. Isolates the cost of the fee.

fees_crowded.title: Taker fee, crowded (today)
fees_crowded.blurb: Fees, makers re-quoting every ~0.3 s off a 50 ms feed, and co-located rivals sniping in ~20 ms.
